credits: Stars: ESA Hipparcos (I/311, I/239 via VizieR). The Hipparcos Catalogue (ESA 1997, SP-1200) and Hipparcos, the New Reduction (van Leeuwen 2007, A&A 474, 653), through the VizieR catalogue access tool, CDS, Strasbourg (CfA and IDIA mirrors). Names and designations: d3-celestial by Olaf Frohn (BSD-3-Clause, see LICENSE-d3-celestial.txt), which collects the IAU WGSN star names. Constellations: IAU boundaries (Roman 1987) via astropy. Temperatures: estimated from B-V (Ballesteros 2012).
notes: Records are little-endian float32, 8 per star in the order of 'fields'; NaN means unknown.
ra, dec: degrees, ICRS, moved from the Hipparcos epoch J1991.25 to epoch_jyear with the star's proper motion (zero radial velocity).
vmag: Johnson V from I/239; for 0 stars without V it is the Hipparcos Hp magnitude.
plx: Hipparcos parallax in mas (I/311); NaN when not positive or less than 5 times its formal error (no reliable distance); meta 'e_plx' holds the error for every star.
pmra (mu_alpha * cos dec), pmdec: proper motion in mas/yr (I/311).
teff: estimated from B-V with Ballesteros (2012), B-V clipped to [-0.4, 2.0]; not a spectroscopic temperature, no correction for interstellar reddening.
rgb: sRGB colour of a blackbody at teff (CIE 1931 2-degree colour matching, D65 white), brightest channel 255; white where B-V is unknown.
Each tier holds the stars with the previous tier's vmax < vmag <= vmax, brightest first.

meta: hip (Hipparcos number), sp (spectral type, I/239), con (IAU constellation), e_plx (mas), names keyed by record index (d3-celestial: proper name, Bayer, Flamsteed, variable-star and Gliese designations).
collections.json: {tier, index} references; nearest uses reliable parallaxes only.
